title: Communication: Waiting dog
characterDescription: a young shibainu with a scarf that is waiting at home for next instructions
concept:
You pass all the raw information you collected to your boss, and then wait for the next instruction.
You don’t try to organize or interpret the facts yourself before giving it to your boss.
Even if you do a little bit of that, you’re not trying to figure out the next steps.
This will not help you step up in your career.
